title: NASA updates lander plans for Moon landings, finally solves long-festering Orion issue
summary: "We have the mandate, we have the resources, and the support from our stakeholders."
llm_summary: NASA has revised its lunar‑lander strategy, clearing a lingering technical snag that had been holding up the Orion spacecraft’s integration with upcoming Moon missions. With the problem finally solved, the agency says it now has the mandate
